thread:
jordan: quick follow-up from today's all-hands — thanks everyone for the questions. i'm dropping a short clarifying thread for the API / Console / Optimize timelines asked about earlier.

anya: thanks — can you confirm the expected GA window for the Optimize suggestions UI? we need it for Q3 planning.

jordan: Optimize suggestions UI is targeted for 'early Q3' for hosted customers. Dedicated/private will be phased in later (Q3->Q4). exact GA depends on a final round of usability fixes next week.

michael: by "Optimize suggestions" do you mean the interactive console suggestions (in-console) or the backend optimizer that proposes batching/quantization? we need to map owners.

jordan: both — separate rollouts. in-console suggestions (Console) are owned by devex/UI (lina). backend recommendation engine (Optimize) is owned by eng-optimize (michael + sam). Console first, then Optimize.

lina: console folks here — confirmation: interactive suggestions feature will be behind a beta flag in the console for early Q3. beta includes: prompt-set templates, per-route batching hints, and one-click apply for suggested cache rules.

sam: Optimize backend status: core recommender prototype done, running synthetic evals against internal workloads. next up: integrate with perf telemetry and wire up rollout gating. estimating canary mid-Q3.

anya: can we get a short rollout plan we can use in customer comms? high level (beta -> canary -> GA) with owners, please.

michael: here's a concise plan we can share:

```
Beta (early Q3): Console UI behind flag for hosted customers. owners: lina (Console), devex. includes UI + basic suggestions (batch size, prefix cache).
Canary (mid Q3): Enable Optimize backend recommendations for 10% of traffic; autoscale monitors + fallback to current config. owners: michael, sam (Optimize eng) + infra.
GA (late Q3): Full rollout for hosted; Dedicated on reserved schedule (customer opt-in, Q3->Q4). Private deployments: SDK & config release in Q4.
```

jordan: pinging @lina @michael — please add SLAs/limits we should communicate. also, any compatibility caveats (model types / quant levels)?

lina: Console will show compatibility per model; initial support: transformer decoder-only models (FP16/INT8 profiles). we'll display "supported / limited / unsupported" badges in the UI.

sam: Optimize recommendations will include quantization suggestions but we'll mark risky combos (e.g., 4-bit on some open models) as "experimental". defaults will not change existing serving configs unless customer clicks accept.

anya: perfect. also customers asked about canary rollback criteria — what metric thresholds will trigger rollback?

michael: primary metrics: tail latency p95, token cost delta, and quality regressions measured by prompt-set evals. immediate rollback if p95 increases > 25% or quality delta exceeds configured threshold for 3 consecutive runs.

ops-bot: deploy-checklist: Canary run must include smoke tests, latency probes, and cost accounting enabled. See: https://internal.redwood/optimize/canary-playbook

jordan: action items:
- lina: draft beta release note + UI screenshots by Mon EOD (owner: lina)
- michael & sam: publish canary gating doc (metrics + alert thresholds) by Wed
- anya: prepare customer-facing timeline blurb for Friday

lina: noted, will share a short mockup in #design later today.

sam: i'll start the canary DAG and add perf probes. linking PR when ready.

anya: thanks all. one last ask — can we include an example API call in the customer blurb showing how "apply suggestion" looks? small snippet for docs?

michael: example snippet for docs: `POST /v1/projects/{proj}/routes/{route}/optimize/apply` body: `{ "suggestion_id": "sugg-2023-09-01", "apply_mode": "preview" }`

lina: love that. i'll wire it into the console mock.

jordan: great thread — i'll update the roadmap doc with these milestones after the owners post the deliverables. closing here unless anyone has new blockers. :thumbsup:
